summary: Old tower recorded at McGarry, Ontario, near Virginiatown; a provincial reserve statement describes an old fire tower, and a community post calls it abandoned.

facts.status_note: A fire-tower group post calls it abandoned; no official record confirms its condition.

evidence.supports: Register repeats the reserve statement's wording about an old fire tower in Part 2
evidence.quote: An old fire tower is present in the northern section of Part 2 and is linked to the eastern access routes previously mentioned

evidence.supports: Canada Lookouts list places McGarry at Virginiatown
Reserve: 1,434 ha of Crown land southeast of Virginiatown
evidence.quote: The McGarry Township Forest Conservation Reserve is a 1,434 ha parcel of Crown land that is situated southeast of Virginiatown

evidence.supports: Reserve statement mentions an old fire tower in the northern section of Part 2
evidence.quote: An old fire tower is present in the northern section of Part 2

evidence.supports: Community post calls it an abandoned tower southeast of Virginiatown
evidence.quote: Abandoned tower known as the McGarry Tower located south east of Virginiatown in northern Ontario

sources.title: McGarry Township Forest Conservation Reserve Management Statement
Abandoned tower known as the McGarry Tower (group post)

notes_for_editor: Thin. The register's McGarry entry gives only a location and a survey note that is copied word for word from the Ontario reserve statement, and that copied note also says access to the site is excellent and that trails from the road were not easily seen in the aerial survey; the story does not use the access claim. The statement describes an old tower in its Part 2 but does not name it or say it is the McGarry tower, so the link is an inference from the register. The Canada Lookouts McGarry page has no content beyond its name; its Ontario list entry gives Virginiatown only. The Facebook post was readable only as its title, and it is community testimony; it is the only current-condition claim. A search snippet for the same post also gives a distance to the road and no maintained trail, but that text was not on the readable page, so it is not used. No build date, height, design or managing agency for the tower was found. The brief has no local_unit, so the story names McGarry Township and Virginiatown as the sources do.
